If you're looking for a ~1 kWh LiFePO4 (LFP) portable power station that you can expand later by adding an external battery, there are several good options from EcoFlow, BLUETTI, and Anker.

The important distinction is that some 1 kWh power stations support a dedicated expansion battery, while others only support charging from another power source. You want the former, so you can increase usable capacity without replacing the power station.

Models to avoid if expansion is essential

One important consideration: an expansion battery increases runtime, not AC output wattage.

Are you planning to expand from 1 kWh to around 2 kWh, or eventually to 4–5 kWh? That makes a big difference in which model offers the best value.
